scenes.say: This might be the most famous photo ever taken on the Moon.
scenes.visual: The photo; MOON set behind Aldrin (cut-out on top) on @Moon.

scenes.say: Neil Armstrong took it, in July 1969.
scenes.visual: Photo credit chip on @Armstrong, date on @July.

scenes.say: Now look at the visor. That's Armstrong, reflected.
scenes.visual: Close-up on the visor, ring on @reflected.

scenes.say: He carried the camera, so almost every photo from that walk shows Buzz Aldrin.
scenes.visual: Aldrin cut out over a darkened photo, name on @Aldrin. Credit.
